title: Cone Snail: Pick Up This Shell and It Harpoons You. Would Meatball Survive? 🐚
tiktok_caption: cone snail 🐚 pick up this pretty shell and it can stab you with a venom harpoon. Stings have killed at least 36 people, and it hunts fish with insulin. Would you pick up a shell on the reef? 🐚 yes / 🙅 no #conesnail #venomous #wouldmeatballsurvive #meatballmyths #oceanlife

beats.say: Pick up this pretty shell, and it can stab you with a venom harpoon.
Cone snail stings have killed at least thirty six people.
The geography cone snail. Almost all of those deaths came from this one kind.
Its harpoon is a hollow tooth, like a needle, fired from a long tube.
Its venom mixes hundreds of different toxins.
And there's no antivenom for it.
Would Meatball survive? Probably. Most people stung on record lived. Just don't pick it up.
It hunts fish. It opens its mouth wide, like a net.
Then it lets out insulin into the water.
The fish's blood sugar crashes, and the whole school gets dizzy.
Then the snail swallows them whole.
One person stung by a cone snail felt a burning pain right away.
But a toxin from a cone snail became a painkiller drug, approved in the US.
It's made for severe pain that other medicines can't help.
People have recorded cone snail stings since the sixteen hundreds.
The geography cone alone causes more than half of all known stings.
Would you pick up a shell on the reef?
Follow me. Next, would Meatball survive the blue-ringed octopus?
